plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: InventoryCleaner
plugins.Punchline: Clears gear your gearsets don't use out of the Armoury Chest.
plugins.Description:
Tidies the Armoury Chest against your saved gearsets. Anything equipped, referenced by a gearset, or a higher-ilvl upgrade for a job you still play is kept; everything else is moved out to your bags, fullest armoury container first, so the run frees space where it is tightest. Every run is previewed item by item with the reason for each decision, and nothing moves until you confirm.

Also does the reverse (pulling gearset pieces back into the armoury) and offers a discard picker: an icon grid of leftover gear, framed by rarity, where anything equipped, in a gearset, or on your allowlist is never listed.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: GlamourLink
plugins.Punchline: Wears the outfit from an Eorzea Collection link. Needs Glamourer.
plugins.Description:
Paste an Eorzea Collection link and wear the outfit. Every slot is shown before anything is applied: what matched, what was a guess, and what could not be found. Requires Glamourer, which does the actual dressing.

Save outfits to a local library that keeps its gear, so wearing one again needs no network call. Open /glink to import, /glink library to browse.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: Gardener
plugins.Punchline: Reminds you when your garden beds need care, and tends a whole patch in one go.
plugins.Description:
Keeps a journal of every outdoor garden bed you own, on personal, FC and shared estates, and reminds you wherever you are when a crop needs tending, fertilizing or harvesting. While you stand at the plot, it can tend, fertilize, harvest or plant the whole patch in one pass, and it plans crossbreed layouts from a bundled dataset. It never travels, mounts or pathfinds for you.

This automates gameplay, which breaks the FFXIV User Agreement and can get your account penalized or banned. Use it at your own risk.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: SealHunter
plugins.Punchline: Clears your Grand Company or class/job hunting log for you.
plugins.Description:
Works through a hunting log for you: the Grand Company log for seals, or your current class/job log for XP. Pick which in settings. It teleports and flies to each zone, walks to the targets with vnavmesh and kills the marks with BossMod Reborn's autorotation.

Needs vnavmesh, Lifestream and BossMod Reborn. AutoDuty is optional and handles the dungeon marks in the Grand Company log.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (XivHub fork)
plugins.Punchline: Runs Cosmic Exploration missions for you and picks the ones that level your relic fastest.
plugins.Description: Runs Cosmic Exploration missions on its own. This XivHub fork scores missions by relic XP per second so it doesn't overshoot what a relic step needs, adds modes that switch jobs to level every crafter or farm every relic, and brings back gathering automation.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: RetainerReach
plugins.Punchline: Shows all your retainers' items in one grid and retrieves them in one click. Needs AllaganTools.
plugins.Description:
Shows your character's and all your retainers' inventories in one icon grid, laid out like the game's own. Select items and press Retrieve: it summons each retainer holding them at a nearby Summoning Bell and moves the items into your bags. You can search by name, filter by category or crafting material, save pulls you repeat as presets, and retrieve from chat with /retrieve.

Needs AllaganTools (also called Allagan Market or InventoryTools) installed and enabled; RetainerReach reads retainer inventories from it. It acts in game for you, using the bell and retrieving items, so use it at your own risk under the game's Terms of Service.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: FeteTimer
plugins.Punchline: Alerts you before each Firmament Fête starts.
plugins.Description: Counts down to the next Ishgardian Restoration Fête (Skyrise Celebration). It reads the time from the objective list while you are in the Firmament, then alerts you by chat, notification or sound at the lead times you choose.

plugins.Author: XivHub
plugins.Name: AutoPincher
plugins.Punchline: Reprices all your retainer listings 1 gil under the cheapest seller, in one click.
plugins.Description:
Undercuts the cheapest competing listing by 1 gil for every item your retainers are selling. It reads your listings from game memory and uses the market board's Compare Prices to find the lowest current price. It never goes below what a vendor would pay or above your own cheapest copy, and it ignores your other retainers and housing mannequins, so two of your retainers selling the same item don't undercut each other.

Nothing is sent to a server unless you turn on the developer log and point it at your own. Adds an Auto Pinch button next to AutoRetainer's retainer list and a /autopinch command for the open retainer. AutoRetainer is optional; if it is installed, its automation pauses during a run.

plugins.Author: xivhub
plugins.Name: Artisan (XivHub fork)
plugins.Punchline: Crafting automation. This fork adds saved FC Workshop presets and fixes under-crafted intermediates.
plugins.Description: Crafting lists, macros and automation. This XivHub fork improves FC Workshop crafting: you can add parts or phases to the open list and save workshop presets. It also fixes intermediates being under-crafted, the craft order, and progress and ETA when steps are skipped.
